Initial release — AI-powered plant root health analysis for transparent pots and smart seedling boxes.

- Analyzes root images/videos for tip color, hair density, branching, and root rot symptoms using fixed cameras.
- Outputs root health score (0-100) and vitality grade (Healthy/Normal/Weak/Rotten), with care guidance based on visual assessment.
- Supports use in smart seedling boxes, transparent pots, plant factories, and hydroponic setups.
- Implements strict open-id acquisition process for saving and querying reports—no execution allowed without a valid open-id.
- Allows users to query structured historical analysis reports via clear trigger keywords, displaying results as Markdown tables with direct report links.
- No specific medical or chemical advice; focuses solely on visual root diagnostics and care suggestions.
